programme.title: Victorious: The Great Ping-Pong Scam

programme.title: Victorious: Wok Star

programme.title: Victorious: Wi-Fi in the Sky

programme.title: Victorious: Freak the Freak Out

programme.title: Victorious: Beck Falls for Tori

programme.title: Victorious: Helen Back Again

programme.title: Victorious: Tori Gets Stuck

programme.title: Victorious: Tori Tortures Teacher
programme.desc: The kids take Sikowitz to the theater to celebrate his ten-year teaching anniversary, but the play's subject sends Sikowitz into a deep depression. Tori must cheer him up.

programme.title: Victorious: Jade Gets Crushed

programme.title: Victorious: Who Did it to Trina?

programme.title: Iceman Cometh
programme.desc: While a royal guard pursues an evil rapist, they are accidentally frozen. Thawed out to modern-day Hong Kong, the pursuit to uphold justice continues.

programme.title: The Tigers
programme.desc: Five cops find their careers and their lives in jeopardy when they accept a 10 million dollar bribe from a drug smuggler, to release him from custody during a drug bust.

programme.title: Wo Hu
programme.desc: The Hong Kong police deploys undercover agents to dismantle a triad syndicate. Betrayal and murder erupt in violent confrontations between the 'brothers' and the law.

programme.title: The Duel
programme.desc: Jie was hunted by killers as he takes the blame for killing the head of a triad. Jie killed his enemies with Nan's help, not knowing that Nan has killed his father.

programme.title: 3AM The Driver
programme.desc: A taxi driver who judges others by his own standards sets out to help 'victims' in his own way. When a woman he likes seems to be bullied by her son, he tries to help her.

programme.title: Ultimate Mission
programme.desc: A deadly virus erupts on a Pacific island. A three-man special ops team infiltrates on a 48-hour rescue mission, battling rebels and time in a desperate fight.

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: Legendary swordswoman Leng Yu Tsui lives in seclusion after betrayal by the Black Yama. When old enemies return, she and her young disciple join forces in battle.

programme.title: Clean My Name, Mr Coroner
programme.desc: An undercover cop framed for murder is forced to take a coroner hostage so as to prove his innocence in the murder of his partner.

programme.title: Trivisa
programme.desc: At the dawn of 1997, three notorious Hong Kong thieves coincidentally meet in a restaurant, sparking rumours of a huge combined heist.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man is forced to leave home and work to support his family by teaching martial arts skills for self-defense.

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: To save the loyal General Yue Fei from a deadly plot, Miao Lung leads patriots to intercept twelve gold medallions carrying a corrupt chancellor's execution order.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Shanghai
programme.desc: A labourer moves to Shanghai in the hope of becoming rich, but has to use his kung fu skills to survive, as well as to take revenge against the gang who killed his brother.

programme.title: Guns & Roses
programme.desc: Jin Shui risks everything to save his family, fleeing France with the help of his friend. Amid challenges, Jin Shui faces a dilemma: love or loyalty to his friend.

programme.title: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: Constable Zhan Zhao is constantly at loggerheads with Bai Yu Tong. Unbeknownst to Zhan, Bai is a girl subtly vying for his heart amidst their escalating conflicts.

programme.title: House of Traps
programme.desc: A team of skilled fighters navigate a house rigged with an array of ingenious and deadly traps.

programme.title: Wild Search
programme.desc: In a gun trafficking raid, a police officer finds the little girl who witnessed her mother's murder by the ruthless gunrunners, and must protect her from being killed.

programme.title: 3AM The Hospital
programme.desc: A woman in hospital discovers her husband's affair and encounters another victim of the affair. Is this entity a figment of her imagination or a vengeful spirit?

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: A Vietnam vet who's now an 'honourable' mercenary-for-hire taking on an assignment tracking down an assassin who's fled to Cambodia after murdering an industrialist from Hong Kong.

programme.title: Once A Gangster
programme.desc: Two former gangsters are tapped to run in an election for leader of the triad gang, but both want to preserve their peaceful lives. Each must outwit the other to win.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: Detective Chang hunts three robbers who have stolen newly issued currency. After taking down one of them, he stops the other two from robbing a gold factory amid chaos.

programme.title: Kungfu Cyborg: Metallic Attraction
programme.desc: An advanced cyborg cop is created as a crime fighter for the villagers in 2046. It can overcome most challenges except for love and battling a rogue cyborg.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: An underground boxer loses his memory while escaping from the Bangkok triad. When he regains his memory after starting anew, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: 3AM The Campus
programme.desc: A school girl joins a horror video project filmed in an old building near her campus to take revenge on a bullying gang, even at the expense of sacrificing the innocents...

programme.title: My Young Auntie
programme.desc: An early 20th century family dispute over property. After the death of an aged man, his young widow fights for what is rightfully hers.

programme.title: Vengeance
programme.desc: A psychotic younger brother is driven to avenge his older brother's death.

programme.title: The Best of Best
programme.desc: Jie has joined the SDU and vows to uphold law and justice. However, as he falls in love with the daughter of a triad boss who killed his father, he is torn between love, family and duty.

programme.title: The Hidden Enforcers
programme.desc: A retired police officer trains four assassins to punish wrongdoers who escape conviction. However, his good intentions turn sour when the assassins kill the cops.

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Three men, crippled by an evil warlord, become friends and learn kung fu with the help of an old teacher and his idiot pupil.

programme.title: Young Heroes Of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: Set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, a young man Chen Zhen, rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: Kung-fu master 'Liu Chia Liang', lent his superior expertise when playing the director's role in Heroes Of The East.

programme.title: Fist of Fury
programme.desc: Master Huo's disciple Liu Jing inherits his skills. Years later, Liu confronts Blood Demon to protect Huo's clan, uphold justice, and prove his master's legacy.

programme.title: The Moon Warrior
programme.desc: A benevolent fisherman living a simple life is reluctantly drawn into helping a noble emperor regain his throne from his evil brother.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover to gain the trust of criminal Tian. Shan helps Tian rise to the head of his gang.

programme.desc: A nail-biting survival thriller. After climbing an abandoned 2000-foot radio tower, best friends Becky and Hunter find themselves trapped at the top with no way down.

programme.title: Asphalt City

programme.title: Into The Deep
programme.desc: An intense action thriller. A young woman is swept off her feet by a mysterious stranger who promises her a romantic boat trip. What follows is deceit, mistrust and violence.

programme.title: Detective Knight: Rogue
programme.desc: Bruce Willis propels this action film. After they shoot his partner, a veteran detective pursues a group of thieves from LA to New York but soon finds his past conflicting with his case.

programme.title: Operation Mincemeat
programme.desc: John Madden brings to life a remarkable true story that shows that all is fair in war. Two British intelligence officers devise a deceptive plan to outwit German troops during WWII.

programme.title: Kings Of Mulberry Street
programme.desc: What if the only way two young Kwazulu Natal boys, can defeat the bullying local crime lord who's threatening their families, is through their belief that one can be a Bollywood hero.

programme.title: Mosley
programme.desc: An enchanting family animation. Mosley rebels from a life of servitude to uncover the origins of his species after learning that his fellow thoriphants used to stand upright.

programme.title: The Ant Bully
programme.desc: A fun and colourful animated adventure with the voices of Julia Roberts and Nicholas Cage. A ten-year-old boy is shrunk down to the size of an ant after he floods a colony.

programme.title: Dogtanian And The Three Muskehounds
programme.desc: A canine remake of a 1980s cartoon. Dogtanian goes to Paris to join the Muskehounds, and when the evil Richelieu plots to seize power, he and the trio must defend the King.

programme.title: Oh Schuks... I'm Gatvol!
programme.desc: Leon Schuster pokes fun at crime in South Africa in this story of two friends who move to Australia for a better life but find themselves on a plane with two terrorists.

programme.title: A Thousand Words
programme.desc: Eddie Murphy learns why silence is golden in this hilarious comedy. A fast-talking agent must watch his every word after a spiritual guru attempts to teach him a valuable lesson.

programme.title: Marry Me
programme.desc: Jennifer Lopez and Owen Wilson are thrown together in this heart-warming, crazy rom-com. A pop star marries a stranger from the audience after being betrayed by her fianc.

programme.title: The Scorpion King
programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson takes his Scorpion King character from 'The Mummy Returns' into its own adventure in this spin-off film about a desert warrior trying to oust a ruthless tyrant.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser and Arnold Vosloo face off once again in this sequel. The mummy is resurrected once again. But there is another threat: the Scorpion King and his undead army.

programme.title: The Fate Of The Furious
